sup:70620.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are delighted to assist Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH and remain eager to serve all your requirements from our extensive product range.

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €4.96 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, and a contract term of 12 months. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

To give you complete visibility into our underlying costs, please note that LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 10 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C2815 rose 0.8 % in twelve months and is 65 % of our cost. 

As your trusted partner, we pride ourselves on exceptional distributor service and look forward to continuing our successful business relationship.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

move.subject: Renewal of framework agreement 4600070620 - 6306-2Z C3
move.body:
Dear Mr Gruber,

thank you for your offer. We would like to renew on a multi-year basis: a binding 20,000 pieces a year for 36 months - the kind of agreement your colleagues told us changes prices.

Straight talk: over the last 12 months we paid 84% of your invoices late, on average 3.5 days after the due date. That is on us, and it ends with this contract: every invoice paid on the due date.

We propose the two attached term sheets: EUR 4.84 at 90 days net, or EUR 4.80 at 30 days net, both for 36 months and 20,000 pieces a year.

Kind regards
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Dear customer,
Thank you very much for your message - it is always a pleasure to hear from you, and we are glad to help wherever we can.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €4.88 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 36 months.
Here is the background.
Thank you for your proposal and the prospect of a 36-month agreement for 20,000 units annually.
In response to this extended term, we can offer a revised price of EUR 4.88 per unit at 30 days net.
Could you please provide the correspondence from our colleagues regarding price changes so we may review the context?
Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data.
We look forward to doing good business together, and our team is always there for you.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

As your dependable partner for premium components, we are always eager to support your operations and provide you with the exceptional service and extensive product range you expect from us. Regarding this project, our offer of a price of €4.88 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 36 months remains our best possible proposal.

Please note that this offer stays valid for 30 days. We look forward to continuing our valued partnership with Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH and remaining your trusted supplier.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH
